about: Labels the on-device meal recogniser chooses from. kind is 'dish' (food with a cuisine), 'drink' (cuisine can be null), 'otherFood' or 'notFood'. Each label has a few descriptions; MobileCLIP turns them into embeddings that are averaged. 'menuNames' are the restaurant menu items the label stands for. After editing, run: python3 Tools/make_dish_embeddings.py
